name: Christian Robertson
bio: Christian Robertson hails from Walnut Creek, California, where he runs the Betatype foundry [betaype.com]. His formal training is in Graphic Design with a BFA from Brigham Young University in Provo, Utah. Aside from designing types and posting to the betatype.com blog, Christian works as an Associate Director of Visual Design at Punchcut, a San Francisco based interface design company.
